chunks: He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Katib narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Abu Khaythamah narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Dahir narrated to us, from al-A’mash, from Abayah al-Asadi, from Ibn Abbas — may Allah have mercy on him — who said:

Amirul Mu'mineen Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, was asked about the verse of the Exalted: "Surely, Allah's devotees shall have no fear, neither shall they grieve." He was asked: "Who are those devotees?"

So Amirul Mu'mineen, peace be upon him, said: "They are a people who purified themselves in His worship and looked at the inner core of this world while people looked at its exterior; they recognized its future while others were deceived by its transitory benefits. They forsook all that which they knew would someday forsake them, and they caused to die all that which they knew would one day kill them."

Then he said: "O he who has deluded himself with this world, running after its traps, striving busily to build up that which will soon be destroyed by it. Did you not see the fate of your forefathers in decomposition, and your descendants beneath the stones and earth? How many times you nursed the sick with your hands and tried to cure them with your palms, seeking prescriptions from the doctors and entreating the loved ones. But your efforts did not avail them, nor did your medicines have any effect upon them."

key_terms.آجلها: its future consequence; the ultimate outcome of worldly engagement which is departure and loss
key_terms.أولياء الله: devotees or close friends of Allah; those who enjoy divine proximity through sincere worship and detachment from worldly illusions
key_terms.باطن الدنيا: the inner reality of this world; its hidden nature that only the spiritually aware perceive
key_terms.ظاهرها: its outward appearance; the superficial aspect of worldly life that deceives most people
key_terms.عاجلها: its immediate pleasures; the transitory benefits that distract from spiritual awareness

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about who the devotees (awliya) of Allah are in Quran 10:62?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), when asked about the Quranic verse 10:62 identifying Allah's devotees (awliya), explained that they are those who purified their worship for Allah alone and saw the inner reality of this world while others were deceived by its outward appearance. They recognized the world's transient nature and abandoned what they knew would eventually abandon them. He then delivered a powerful admonition about death's inevitability, asking the listener to reflect on their ancestors' decomposition and the futility of medical treatment when Allah decrees death. This teaching was delivered in the context of interpreting the concept of wilayah (divine friendship/proximity), a central theological concept in Shia Islam.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 2. He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Katib, who reported from Ahmad ibn Abu Khaithamah, who reported from Abdullah ibn Dahir, from al-A’amash, from Abayah al-Asadi from Ibn Abbas - may Allah bless him with mercy, who said:

Amirul Mu’mineen ‘Ali ibn ‘Ali Talib, peace be upon him, was asked about the verse in the Qu’ran: ’Surely, Allah’s devotees shall have no fear, neither shall they grieve.’ (Yunus, 10:62). He was asked: "Who are those devotees?"

So, Amirul Mu’mineen, peace be upon him, said: "They are the ones who have purified themselves in His worship and have an eye on the inner core of this world while people regard its exterior; and so they have recognized its future while others have been deceived by its transitory benefits. They have forsaken all that which they know will someday forsake them and have caused to die all that they know will one day kill them."

Then he said: "O he who has distracted himself with this world and jumped at its traps, working busily to build up that which will soon be destroyed by it. Did you not see your forefathers, who are down decomposing and your descendants, thrown under the stone and earth? How you tried to treat them and cure them with your hands? The doctors prescribed for them and the relatives prayed for them. But reliance upon you, did not help them and your medicines did not have any effect upon them."
